serverInfo.name: zillapi
serverInfo.title: Zillapi - Zillow Data API
serverInfo.description: MCP server exposing Zillapi's Zillow Data API as agent tools. Look up U.S. properties by address or zpid, fetch Zestimates, and search listings inside a bounding box.

tools.name: lookup_property_by_address
tools.title: Look up a U.S. property by address
tools.description: Returns full Zillow property data for a U.S. address.

tools.name: lookup_property_by_zpid
tools.title: Look up a U.S. property by Zillow zpid
tools.description: Returns full property data for a Zillow property id. Cache-served when fresh.

tools.name: get_zestimate
tools.title: Get the current Zestimate for a property
tools.description: Returns Zillow's automated valuation and rent Zestimate for a zpid.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.title: Search U.S. property listings
tools.description: Search for-sale, for-rent, or sold listings inside a geographic bounding box.

authentication.instructions: Two ways to connect: (1) OAuth 2.1 — add this server as a connector at https://claude.ai/settings/connectors (Anthropic UI), or any MCP client that supports Dynamic Client Registration. The first time you connect, you'll be prompted to authorize on zillapi.com. (2) Long-lived API key — get a free key with 100 credits at https://zillapi.com/signup (no card required), then send 'Authorization: Bearer zk_<key>' with every request. Both modes share the same /v1 REST and /mcp tool surface.
